title: Design System: From The Farm Pricing Calculator

display.purpose: Step titles. One per screen. Always uppercase, always navy.

headline.purpose: Section breaks within a step. Uppercase navy.

title.purpose: Group labels (animal tiles, card headers). Uppercase navy.

body.purpose: All running text. Press-ink on cream. Cap at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Form-field labels and badge text. Uppercase, +0.08em tracking.

button.purpose: Every button label. Uppercase Oswald — the action voice of the system.

eyebrow.purpose: The 'Step X of 5' line above a Display title. Always gold, always uppercase.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default lift for elevated paper — wizard cards, animal tiles at rest, the results dashboard frame.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Selected / hovered / focused lift. Active animal tile, primary CTA on hover, anything the system is calling attention to.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for color, opacity, and shadow transitions. Used on hover and focus.

motion.name: tile-spring
motion.purpose: Animal-tile hover scale (1.04) and tap scale (0.97). Mechanical and confident, never bouncy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default forward-momentum CTA — Continue, Calculate, Save. Navy fill, uppercase Oswald, 48px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; background: #1B3A6B; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #173360; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,58,107,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(27,58,107,0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F8F6F1, 0 0 0 4px rgba(181,150,90,0.66); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #14305A; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(27,58,107,0.40); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: Celebratory or final-action CTA — most often the primary on the Results step. Used at most once per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; background: #B5965A; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #A4864E; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(27,58,107,0.18); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F8F6F1, 0 0 0 4px rgba(181,150,90,0.66); } .ds-btn-gold:active { background: #927846; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Companion to the primary. White fill, navy text, navy-tinted border. Save for later, Edit costs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1B3A6B; border: 1px solid rgba(27,58,107,0.20); border-radius: 8px; font-family: Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(27,58,107,0.50); background: rgba(27,58,107,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F8F6F1, 0 0 0 4px rgba(181,150,90,0.66); }

components.name: Animal Tile (selected)
components.description: The signature Step 1 picker, in its selected state. Gold ring, gold border, lifted card shadow.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 112px; padding: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E0D5; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-tile:hover { border-color: rgba(27,58,107,0.40); transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-tile:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-tile--active { border-color: #B5965A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(181,150,90,0.40), 0 1px 2px rgba(27,58,107,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(27,58,107,0.08); } .ds-tile__emoji { font-size: 1.875rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-tile__label { font-family: Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1B3A6B; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default elevated paper surface. Wizard step containers, results panels, anything that lifts off the cream canvas.
components.html:
Cost summary
Per pound, all-in: $11.42
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E0D5; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,58,107,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(27,58,107,0.08); } .ds-card__header { padding: 20px 24px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E0D5; } .ds-card__title { font-family: Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1B3A6B; } .ds-card__body { padding: 16px 24px 20px; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #1A1A1A; }

components.name: Number Input
components.description: Field-side numeric input with a unit suffix. Min 44px tall, gold focus ring shared with every other interactive element.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E0D5; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: #1B3A6B; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(181,150,90,0.40); } .ds-input input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: #6B6B6B; } .ds-input__suffix { padding-left: 8px; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #6B6B6B; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Switch with a label and optional description. Whole row is the hit target.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; } .ds-toggle__rail { position: relative; width: 48px; height: 28px; flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0; background: #1B3A6B; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-toggle__rail--off { background: #E5E0D5; } .ds-toggle__knob { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 20px; height: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,58,107,0.20); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-toggle__rail--on .ds-toggle__knob { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-toggle__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-toggle__label { font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; color: #1A1A1A; } .ds-toggle__desc { font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; color: #6B6B6B; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: The wizard progress bar. Eyebrow row above, gold-on-cream track, step labels below.

components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 720px; padding: 16px; } .ds-progress__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-progress__count { color: #6B6B6B; } .ds-progress__name { color: #1B3A6B; } .ds-progress__track { position: relative; height: 8px; background: #E5E0D5; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress__fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; background: #B5965A; border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-progress__steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); margin-top: 8px; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #6B6B6B; } .ds-progress__step--done { color: #1B3A6B; font-weight: 700; } .ds-progress__step--current { color: #1A1A1A; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
Imagine a farm extension-office bulletin or a county almanac — cream stock, navy ink, a gold seal — but redesigned with the care of a contemporary editorial team. That's the canvas. The page is a warm cream the eye can rest on for ten minutes without fatigue. The display type is condensed and confident, like the masthead on a working publication. Color is rationed: navy carries authority, gold marks what matters, status hues only show up when a number is telling the farmer something. The result is a tool that reads as a real reference document, not a SaaS dashboard.

Three things this system explicitly rejects. It is not a cheap mortgage-calculator descendant — no neon CTAs, no '92% of farmers like you charge more!' trust bars, no urgency timers, no lead-form-as-paywall. It is not twee farm clip-art — no cartoon barns, no marker fonts, no crayon palette, no smiling-cow mascot. And it is not the pastel SaaS calculator that the category-reflex would produce — no indigo gradient hero card, no identical-grid KPI tiles, no stock illustration of a happy farmer. The visual language belongs to the world of working agricultural tools, not the world of growth-marketing landing pages.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper background everywhere — almanac-paper (#F8F6F1) is the canvas, not a card.
Two-color authority structure: navy for action and weight, gold for emphasis and progress.
Condensed-display + humanist-sans pairing (Oswald + Lato) — the masthead and the article body.
Generous touch targets and large numbers — designed for thumbs in the field.
Layered elevation: cards lift, the active animal tile rings up, the primary CTA carries weight.
Status colors (green / amber / red) appear only when a number is telling a story.

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: Navy and gold do all the brand work. Together they cover at most 25% of any given screen. Status hues are signals layered on top of that — never a third brand color.

rules.name: The Cream-Canvas Rule
rules.body: The body is almanac-paper, never #fff. White is reserved for elevated surfaces (cards, inputs, the header bar). The cream-on-white contrast IS the elevation cue. Reversing the two — white body with cream cards — collapses the whole metaphor.

rules.name: The Status-as-Story Rule
rules.body: Green / amber / red appear only when a number is making a recommendation. A green badge that just means 'saved' is a misuse. A green badge under 'Your margin: $4.20/lb' is correct.

rules.name: The Masthead-and-Article Rule
rules.body: Oswald and Lato never trade jobs. Headlines are always Oswald uppercase; body is always Lato sentence-case. Reversing them — Lato uppercase headlines or Oswald body copy — collapses the publication metaphor.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Then-Title Rule
rules.body: Every step opens with an eyebrow (gold uppercase) directly above a Display title (navy uppercase). Two lines. The pattern is the front page of every bulletin section — never breach it.

rules.name: The Two-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Card and pop are the only two shadow tokens. Anything that needs more elevation than pop should be a navy fill or a gold ring instead — not a deeper shadow. Stacking shadows or inventing a third elevation is forbidden.

rules.name: The Navy-Tint Rule
rules.body: Every shadow's RGB is 27, 58, 107 — almanac-navy. A flat-gray rgba(0,0,0,...) shadow is forbidden anywhere in the system. The tint is the difference between a publication's printed lift and a generic 2014 SaaS card.

dos: Do keep almanac-paper (#F8F6F1) as the body canvas everywhere. The cream-on-white elevation cue is half the system.
Do open every step with a gold eyebrow above a navy uppercase Display title. Two lines. No exceptions.
Do use bulletin-gold for the progress bar fill — it's the progress signal across the calculator, not a brand decoration.
Do tint every shadow with rgba(27, 58, 107, ...). Pure black or gray shadows are forbidden.
Do use Oswald uppercase for every button, headline, and active tab. Lato sentence-case for everything a farmer reads.
Do keep status colors (green / amber / red) reserved for moments where a number is telling a story. Never decorative.
Do size touch targets at ≥44px and prefer 48px for primary actions. A glove or thumb in the field has to land it.
Do quote PRODUCT.md's voice in copy: trusted, practical, warm. Plainspoken expertise. Never startup-speak.
Do use the same gold focus ring (ring-gold/40, 2px, 2px offset) on every interactive element — buttons, inputs, animal tiles, toggles.
donts: Don't drift toward the cheap mortgage-calculator family — no trust-bar gauges, no neon CTAs, no urgency timers, no '92% of farmers like you charge more!' social-proof stings, no lead-form-as-paywall.
Don't drift toward twee farm clip-art — no cartoon barns, no smiling-cow mascots, no marker / hand-drawn fonts, no crayon-primary palette, no 'Old MacDonald' energy.
Don't drift toward generic SaaS — no indigo gradients, no hero-metric template, no identical KPI grid, no stock illustration of a happy farmer.
Don't use side-stripe borders. A border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent on cards or callouts is forbidden.
Don't use gradient text. background-clip: text with a gradient is forbidden. Emphasis comes from weight, size, and color.
Don't swap Oswald and Lato's roles. Lato uppercase headlines or Oswald body copy collapses the masthead-and-article metaphor.
Don't introduce a third brand color. Navy and gold are the two-color authority of the system.
Don't add a third elevation shadow. Card and pop are the whole vocabulary.
Don't use #000 or #fff on the body canvas. The body is always almanac-paper.
Don't use modal-as-first-thought. Inline disclosures, tooltips, and progressive reveal beat a modal almost every time in a calculator wizard.
Don't use em dashes in copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
